title: Walmart Stock (WMT) Falls 1.0% After Q3 Earnings (Nov 19)
summary: Walmart (WMT) fell 1.04% to $126.04 on Nov 19 after Q3 results and a raised outlook, as U.S. comps and its sales forecast lagged analyst expectations.
body_markdown:
## Why Walmart Stock Fell


According to[Walmart's third-quarter earnings release](https://corporate.walmart.com/content/dam/corporate/documents/newsroom/2026/11/q3-fy27-earnings/q3-fy27-earnings-release.pdf) dated November 19, 2026, revenue rose 5.2% to $188.8 billion in the quarter ended October 31, 2026, with GAAP EPS of $0.62 and[adjusted EPS](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-eps-earnings-per-share-meaning-formula-and-how-to-judge-it/) of $0.65. The company raised its fiscal 2027 net sales growth outlook to a range of 4.9% to 5.2% in constant currency, up from the 4.0% to 5.0% range it gave on August 20, 2026. It also lifted its adjusted operating income growth outlook to 8.0% to 8.6% and its adjusted EPS outlook to $2.84 to $2.89, from $2.80 to $2.87.


> "We delivered strong results, growing our core business and gaining market share," said John Furner, President and CEO of Walmart, in the release.


Financial media tied the drop to the details behind those figures. As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/walmart-stock-falls-earnings-beat-184813477.html) , Walmart shares fell nearly 2% in Thursday morning trading even though revenue and adjusted EPS topped Wall Street estimates, as investors appeared focused on softer sales growth. U.S. comparable sales growth of 2.9% came in below the 3.1% analysts had expected, and the new full-year sales outlook fell short of the 5.5% analysts had expected, the outlet reported.


## WMT Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Digital growth: global e-commerce sales grew 17% and Walmart U.S. e-commerce rose 23% in the quarter, according to the company's release.
- Advertising and membership: Walmart's global advertising business grew 25%, Walmart U.S. advertising rose 37% and global membership fee revenue grew 17%, per the release.
- Agentic shopping: per[CX Dive](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/walmart-building-omnichannel-environment-around-202728231.html) , usage of Walmart's Sparky shopping assistant rose 129% year over year in the U.S., with customers building 40% larger baskets with the tool.


### Risks


- Slower U.S. comps: Walmart U.S. comparable sales growth eased to 2.9% from 4.5% a year earlier, including a roughly 70 basis point net headwind in health and wellness from deflation tied to maximum fair price regulation, according to the release.
- Cost pressure: Walmart U.S. operating expenses deleveraged 45 basis points, mainly from depreciation and higher claims costs, and global inventory rose 8.1%, the release showed.
- Membership bundle: the release said the new Walmart+ and Sam's Club Plus bundle will weigh on Sam's Club U.S. operating income growth until it is lapped in Q3 FY28, after that segment's operating income fell 15.8% in the quarter.
